```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Mock data
set.seed(42)
df_loadings <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("A", "B", "C"),
  PC1 = runif(3, -1, 1),
  PC2 = runif(3, -1, 1)
)

# Plot
ggplot(df_loadings, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = Variable)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.08, "inches")),
               color = "blue") +
  geom_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = -0.8, size = 2.2) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-1.1, 1.1), ylim = c(-1.1, 1.1)) +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 5)

# To save at 1.1 × 3.5 inches
ggsave("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/paper/figure/pca_loading_mock.png", width = 1.4, height = 1.4, units = "in", dpi = 300)


library(ggplot2)

# ---- Mock data ----
set.seed(42)
n <- c(60, 55, 65)
df <- data.frame(
  x = c(rnorm(n[1], -3, 0.40), rnorm(n[2],  0, 0.50), rnorm(n[3],  3, 0.45)),
  y = c(rnorm(n[1],  0, 0.40), rnorm(n[2],  2.3, 0.45), rnorm(n[3], -0.8, 0.40))
)

# ---- K-means ----
km <- kmeans(df[, c("x","y")], centers = 3, nstart = 25)
df$cluster <- factor(km$cluster)
centers <- as.data.frame(km$centers)

# ---- Plot ----
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x, y, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  # Ellipses to show cluster spread (90%):
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = cluster, color = cluster), level = 0.90, linewidth = 0.3) +
  # Centroids:
  geom_point(data = centers, aes(x, y), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             shape = 8, size = 2.2, stroke = 0.7, color = "black") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "PC 1", y = "PC 2", color = "Cluster") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 5) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p

# Save exactly 3.5 x 1.1 inches
ggsave("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/paper/figure/kmeans_mock_plot.png", p, width = 3.5, height = 1.4, units = "in", dpi = 300)

```
